quickStart.title: Quick start
quickStart.body:
Drag videos or audio files into the window, or click "Add". Files join the queue and are transcribed one at a time.
Segments appear on the side as the transcription progresses. Click a segment to hear that moment.
When it finishes, pick the Text, With timestamps or JSON tab and use Copy or Download.

whichModel.title: Which model should I choose?
whichModel.body:
Small: fastest and lightest; good for computers with little memory.
Medium: balance between speed and accuracy; the default.
Large v3 Turbo: nearly Large v3 accuracy, much faster; great with an NVIDIA GPU.
Large v3: the most accurate and the slowest.

gpu.title: GPU acceleration
gpu.body:
NVIDIA cards (Windows and Linux): use CUDA. Turn it on in Settings → Transcription → Processing; the app downloads the NVIDIA libraries (about 1.2 GB) after you accept the terms. Requires driver 525 or newer.
AMD and Intel cards (Windows and Linux) and Apple Silicon Macs: use the whisper.cpp engine on the GPU (Vulkan or Metal). The app downloads the model in the right format; no extra libraries. On Linux you need the Vulkan driver (e.g. sudo apt install mesa-vulkan-drivers).
If the GPU fails, transcription automatically continues on the CPU. If no compatible card is found, the app tells you and uses the CPU.

unsigned.title: Opening the app for the first time
unsigned.body:
The app is not digitally signed yet, so your system may warn you the first time.
Windows: on the "Windows protected your PC" screen, click "More info" and then "Run anyway".
macOS: right-click the app, choose "Open" and confirm. If that option is missing, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → "Open Anyway".

problems.title: Common problems
problems.body:
Slow transcription: use a smaller model or turn on the NVIDIA GPU.
"The computer ran out of memory": switch to a smaller model in Settings → Transcription.
"This file could not be read": the file may be damaged or in an unsupported format; try converting it to MP3 or MP4.
"The file is no longer in its original location": use "Locate file" on the history item.
Disk full: check the space in use under Settings → Storage.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body:
Everything is processed on your computer. Audio and transcripts are never sent to any server.
The app only goes online to download models, the NVIDIA libraries and to check for new versions (you can turn that off under General).
